title: .config/ianf-worktree-env.toml, version 1
description: Each checkout's own HTTPS hostname, .env and stack, for worktree-env, which reads only the copy committed on the default branch: an edit takes effect once it's committed there. See worktree-env's README.

version.description: The version of this file's format.

name.description: The DNS label under the domain: <slot>.<name>.<domain>.

slots.description: How many worktrees besides the main checkout.

base.description: The branch new worktrees start from. The repository's default branch if left out.

env-file.description: The checkout's .env file, gitignored, from its root.

up.description: Run in a new worktree, to start its stack.

down.description: Run before removing a worktree, to stop its stack and delete its data.

env.description: Variables set in env-file. {slot}, {host} and {dir} are filled in.
